picks.name: Fort Romeau
picks.source_note: Already in your library (featured on Peach Discs' Peach Pals, Vol. 5).
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Lovin' U" (September 11, 2026, Rekids) is a three-track EP -- Lovin' U, No Limit, Breathe (Trip Mix) -- balancing deep house warmth with his ear for hypnotic detail, from a slick vocal groover to an Italo-tinged deep houser to a dubby, church-organ shuffler.
picks.why_listen: Three distinct flavors of deep house from a dependable producer -- silky and groove-forward, useful across different points in a set.

picks.name: Malik Hendricks
picks.source_note: Already in your library (UKHouse playlist). New label discovery: Flat White Records.
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Stretching EP" (March 20, 2026, Flat White Records) is a four-track release -- Stretching, Mono No Aware, After The Rain, Stretching (Beringei Remix) -- leaning between deep house and techno.
picks.why_listen: A solid deep house/techno crossover EP with a strong remix included -- versatile material for a mid-set stretch.
